scope: Known frozen P1 preparation cases reused for regression comparison, not a new blind heldout evaluation. New quality/source tests are separately controlled fixtures.
normalization: Question duplicate comparison removes company and actual profile project names before punctuation/case normalization. JD goal coverage removes skill names and generic role words. Metadata evidence is checked separately, never counted as question relevance.
limitations: These cases were inspected during development and measure regression on known synthetic inputs, not unseen hiring outcomes.
Automatic domain-token overlap, duplicate checks and exact source quotes do not replace independent human review.
No provider inference or live source usefulness is claimed by this offline evaluation.
